name: Staff of the Adder

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Cleric, Druid, or Warlock

powers.name: Snake Head
powers.text: Bonus Action: the staff's head becomes a venomous snake for 1 minute. Its bite: your melee attack, 1d6 Piercing, and a DC 15 Con save or 3d6 Poison.

summary: The head becomes a snake: its bite deals 1d6 Piercing and 3d6 Poison (Con DC 15 avoids the poison).
text: As a Bonus Action, you turn the staff's head into a living, venomous snake's head for 1 minute; another Bonus Action changes it back. While it is a snake, you can attack with it in melee, using your attack bonus: it has 5-foot reach, and a hit deals 1d6 Piercing damage and forces a Constitution saving throw (DC 15), failure meaning 3d6 Poison damage. The living head can itself be attacked: its AC is 15 and it has 20 Hit Points, and reducing it to 0 Hit Points destroys the staff. If the staff survives, it heals fully once it turns inanimate again.
